title: Certificate-Generating Studio Integration
verification_chain: Certificate generated from exact rational source geometry
Geometry-linked Lean MeshCertificate witness source generated
Generated witness compiled by pinned Lean CI PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN
scope: opposite local orientations on paired interior edges
nonempty boundary labels with rejection of labels attached to interior/absent edges
independent exact certificate regeneration and SHA-256 payload attestation
closed geometry-linked Lean MeshCertificate witness rendering
CI smoke compilation of an actually generated Lean witness
Studio registry exposure with connected mesh input or form-driven exact JSON input
evidence_policy: Python exact-checker success is symbolic/exact evidence, not Lean-formal evidence. A generated witness is labeled formally verified only after the pinned Lean CI build for that witness succeeds.
nonclaims: Binary floating-point coordinates are not silently accepted as exact rational geometry.
The Lean renderer currently requires at least one interior and one boundary edge.
The generator does not by itself prove the continuum H1/H(div) theorem.
Continuum H1/H(div) closure is deferred to later releases.
